components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height:38px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:8px; color:var(--ink-strong); background:var(--accent); font:680 13px "Onest", Arial, sans-serif; transition:background 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color:var(--accent-hover); background:var(--accent-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(103,148,64,.3); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height:38px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:8px; color:var(--ink); background:transparent; font:680 13px "Onest", Arial, sans-serif; transition:background 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color:#94aa9d; background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(103,148,64,.3); } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Hands-Free Feather
components.description: Signature dictation command with a clipped lower-left feather corner.
components.css: .ds-record { display:inline-flex; min-width:118px; height:50px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; padding:0 15px; border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:13px 13px 13px 5px; color:var(--ink-strong); background:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(86,119,33,.22); font:720 13px "Onest", Arial, sans-serif; transition:background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-record svg { width:21px; height:21px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-record:hover { background:var(--accent-hover); box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(86,119,33,.3); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-record:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(103,148,64,.3); } .ds-record:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: History search with a compact leading icon.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5"></circle><path d="m12.25 12.25 4 4"></path></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search dictations"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; height:44px; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:0 13px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:9px; background:var(--surface); } .ds-search svg { width:18px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:var(--muted); stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linecap:round; } .ds-search input { width:100%; height:100%; border:0; outline:0; color:var(--ink); background:transparent; font:400 15px "Onest", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search:hover { border-color:#94aa9d; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color:#76a943; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(103,148,64,.3); }

components.name: Rail Navigation Item
components.description: Persistent destination with a chartreuse active-edge tick.
components.css: .ds-nav { position:relative; display:flex; width:158px; min-height:43px; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:0 11px; border:0; border-radius:9px; color:var(--sidebar-muted); background:var(--sidebar); font:570 14px "Onest", Arial, sans-serif; text-align:left; transition:color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav::before { position:absolute; top:12px; bottom:12px; left:-13px; width:3px; border-radius:0 3px 3px 0; background:transparent; content:""; } .ds-nav svg { width:19px; height:19px; fill:currentColor; stroke:none; } .ds-nav:hover { color:var(--sidebar-active); background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); } .ds-nav.active { color:var(--sidebar-active); } .ds-nav.active::before { background:var(--accent); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(103,148,64,.3); }

components.name: Toggle Row
components.description: Direct setting with explanation and leaf-green checked state.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position:relative; display:grid; min-height:58px; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:22px; padding:8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); font-family:"Onest", Arial, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-toggle > span { display:grid; gap:4px; } .ds-toggle strong { font-size:13px; font-weight:660; } .ds-toggle small { color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; } .ds-toggle input { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; opacity:0; } .ds-toggle i { position:relative; width:40px; height:23px; border-radius:99px; background:#9bafa5; transition:background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle i::after { position:absolute; top:3px; left:3px; width:17px; height:17px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(20,58,49,.24); content:""; transition:transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle input:checked + i { background:#679440; } .ds-toggle input:checked + i::after { transform:translateX(17px); } .ds-toggle input:focus-visible + i { box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(103,148,64,.3); }

components.name: Perched Caption
components.description: The live field, session memory, and dark-green dictation perch as one instrument.
components.html:
Live transcript

Your words will appear here as you speak.

MemoryRecent takes stay here.
Hold Ctrl + Space to dictate
components.css: .ds-stage { display:grid; width:680px; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 190px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:18px; color:var(--ink); background:var(--surface); box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(20,58,49,.08); font-family:"Onest", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-live { min-height:250px; padding:27px 30px; border-right:1px solid var(--line); } .ds-live strong,.ds-memory strong { color:var(--ink-strong); font-size:17px; font-weight:690; } .ds-live p { margin:48px 0 0; color:var(--muted); font-size:25px; font-weight:480; line-height:1.48; letter-spacing:-.018em; } .ds-memory { padding:27px 22px; background:#f0f5ee; } .ds-memory small { display:block; margin-top:18px; color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; } .ds-perch { display:flex; min-height:88px; grid-column:1/-1; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:16px 18px; color:var(--sidebar-active); background:var(--sidebar); box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(16,58,49,.16); } .ds-perch button { height:50px; padding:0 15px; border:0; border-radius:13px 13px 13px 5px; color:var(--ink-strong); background:var(--accent); font:720 13px "Onest", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-perch button:hover { background:var(--accent-hover); } .ds-perch button:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(103,148,64,.3); } .ds-perch span { font-size:15px; font-weight:690; }

components.name: Recording Overlay
components.description: Floating state strip using the canonical bird as its signal.
components.css: .ds-overlay { display:grid; width:420px; height:58px; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:0 13px 0 8px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius:15px; color:var(--sidebar-active); background:var(--sidebar); box-shadow:0 16px 38px rgba(7,35,28,.34); font-family:"Onest", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-bird { display:grid; width:42px; height:42px; place-items:center; border-radius:11px; background:#f1f6e8; } .ds-bird svg { width:34px; height:34px; } .ds-overlay-copy { display:grid; gap:3px; min-width:0; } .ds-overlay-copy strong { font-size:13px; font-weight:680; } .ds-overlay-copy small,.ds-overlay b { color:var(--sidebar-muted); font-size:11px; } .ds-overlay:hover { border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2); } .ds-overlay:focus-within { box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(103,148,64,.3),0 16px 38px rgba(7,35,28,.34); }

narrative.overview:
Parrot is the quiet bird at the edge of work: present, recognizable, and ready to catch speech without asking the user to enter a separate AI world. A literal geometric parrot anchors the forest rail, pale mineral surfaces hold the live text, and a dark-green perch carries every dictation control.

The system is calm and editorial rather than dashboard-like. Live words own the largest working type; recent takes remain visible at the right edge; thin rules organize secondary views. The bird appears as the canonical mark, as a faint watermark on the caption field, and as the signal inside the floating overlay without becoming decorative clutter.
keyCharacteristics: Literal right-facing geometric parrot with a hidden P silhouette.
Jungle-green rail and control perch against pale mineral fields.
Leaf and wing chartreuse reserved for commands, focus, and readiness.
Coral beak color echoed only in recording and destructive states.
Onest typography, ruled secondary views, and clipped feather-like control corners.

rules.name: The Plumage Has Jobs Rule
rules.body: Chartreuse marks commands and readiness, coral marks recording or destructive state, and neither becomes an ornamental field color.

rules.name: The Bird Is the Brand Rule
rules.body: Use the canonical full-color SVG; never trace, recolor, outline, animate, or redraw its geometry.

rules.name: The Caption Owns Scale Rule
rules.body: Live transcript text is the largest working content; settings and metadata never compete with it.

rules.name: The Live Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Set “Parrot” as live Onest text at weight 740 beside the mark; never convert it to paths or place it inside the bird tile.

rules.name: The Center Voice, Right Memory Rule
rules.body: Live speech receives the flexible center while recoverable session memory holds the narrower right edge.

rules.name: The One Perch Rule
rules.body: Hands-free, push-to-talk guidance, timer, recovery, and cancellation belong to one dark-green bottom band.

rules.name: The Instrument, Not Cards Rule
rules.body: Elevate the caption and perch as one instrument; persistent rows, settings, and history remain flat.

rules.name: The Perched Silhouette Rule
rules.body: The caption and control perch read as one object; never split them into independent cards.

rules.name: The Feather Cut Rule
rules.body: Asymmetric clipping belongs to the primary dictation action, not every control.

dos: Do use the canonical literal bird consistently across shell, overlay, tray, installer, and release assets.
Do give live speech the flexible center and largest working type.
Do keep chartreuse concentrated on commands, focus, active rail tick, and local readiness.
Do use coral only for the beak, recording, destructive actions, and errors.
Do organize secondary views with mineral fields, shared edges, and thin stem rules.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, text state labels, reduced-motion behavior, and the optical tray crop.
donts: Don't trace, recolor, animate, outline, or decorate the canonical bird.
Don't split caption, memory, and perch into separate rounded cards.
Don't return to an anonymous gray-and-blue dictation dashboard.
Don't use gradients, ornamental waveforms, badge collections, or oversized AI-marketing headlines.
Don't apply the feather cut to ordinary controls or fill active navigation with pills.
Don't copy another dictation product's branding, assets, wording, colors, or pixel-level layout.
